label: Real GDP growth
description: Annual real GDP growth rate. World Bank WDI series back to 1961; NBS national accounts from 2010 (rebased 2014 and 2024).

sources.label: NBS — Nigerian Gross Domestic Product Report

label: Headline inflation (CPI, y/y)
description: Consumer price inflation, year on year. WDI gives the annual average; NBS gives the monthly headline rate. NBS rebased the CPI in January 2025, so record the basis on either side of the break.

sources.label: World Bank WDI — Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)

label: Unemployment rate
description: Share of the labour force without work. ILO-modelled series from 1991 via WDI; NBS labour force surveys used a broader definition until 2020 and switched to the ILO-aligned NLFS in 2023, a basis break.

sources.label: World Bank WDI — Unemployment, total (% of labour force, ILO modelled)

label: Official exchange rate
description: Naira per US dollar at the official or interbank rate, period average or year end as stated per point. Multiple official windows existed 2015-2023; record which one in the basis.

sources.label: World Bank WDI — Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)

label: Petrol pump price
description: Regulated or average retail price of premium motor spirit. Pre-2016 points come from the official regulated price at each change; from 2016 NBS publishes a monthly national average.

sources.label: NNPC / PPPRA — historical PMS price changes
NBS — Premium Motor Spirit (Petrol) Price Watch

label: Total public debt stock
description: Federal government plus states' domestic and external debt, as reported by the DMO from 2000. Earlier totals come from the CBN Statistical Bulletin and cover federal debt only; record that in the basis.

sources.label: DMO — Nigeria's total public debt portfolio

label: External reserves
description: Gross official foreign reserves held by the CBN, year end unless stated.

sources.label: World Bank WDI — Total reserves (includes gold, current US$)

label: Poverty headcount rate
description: Share of the population below the national poverty line (NBS living standards surveys) or the international $2.15 line (WDI). Surveys are infrequent (1985, 1992, 1996, 2003/04, 2009/10, 2018/19); the 2022 multidimensional index is a different measure and is only recorded with basis "multidimensional".

sources.label: World Bank WDI — Poverty headcount ratio at $2.15 a day

label: Internally generated revenue
description: Revenue the state raises itself (taxes, fees, levies), excluding federal allocation. NBS publishes state IGR from 2011; earlier years appear in CBN Annual Report state finance tables.

sources.label: NBS — Internally Generated Revenue at State Level
CBN Annual Report — State government finances

label: Total public debt stock
description: State's domestic plus external debt at year end, from the DMO subnational tables (2011 onward). Where only domestic debt is published the point carries basis "domestic".

label: Approved budget
description: Total appropriation passed for the fiscal year. Neither direction is good in itself; the audit cross-checks these points against the budget table.

sources.label: State appropriation laws and budget speeches

label: Capital expenditure share
description: Capital spending as a share of the approved budget. Use the approved figure unless an actual (implementation) figure is published, and say which in the basis.

label: Out-of-school children
description: Children of primary and junior secondary age not enrolled in school, state estimate. Published only irregularly (UNICEF, UBEC, DHS); record as not published when no state figure exists.

label: Under-five mortality
description: Deaths before age five per 1,000 live births, state estimate from the Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey (2008, 2013, 2018, 2023-24) or MICS (2016-17, 2021). Each survey reports the ten years before it, so attribute a point to the survey year, not the term.
